source_semantics.review: Individually review all four complete files and33 hunks of the inspection API publication. Current Material replaces six private inspection forwards with get-theme-version/type/color/typography/density and theme-has; the experimental resize/popover callers and inspection tests rename those exact calls. No implementation of those functions changes in this commit. All26 source case identities remain; one complete callback is unchanged and25 contain the renamed Sass calls. The authentic retained16 oracle explicitly contains47 variables,25 functions and286 mixins, and none of these six inspection names. That358-member inventory is a historical namespace, not a newly executed Sass seal or an assertion about other argument/CSS case rosters. The owned finite facade forwards owned M2 modules; the complete1028-member source scan finds no new inspection calls, no experimental Material Sass dependency, no current-Material facade forward and no current m2-* call-through. Four already owned companion/current-peer style routes remain explicitly unchanged. Preserve the historical namespace/model, helper names, maps and consumer bindings rather than expanding a modern API mirror or performing a helper-call migration. No product, HTML, CSS, SCSS, golden or consumer API change; real Sass/compiler/peer/native/SSR/floor and mixed M2/M3 coexistence execution remain separate.
